title: Migration 48 — AI cost tracking and budget caps
description: Applies migration 47 then 48 and rolls 48 back; baseline is the state after 47, since 48's rollback reverses only 48. 48 tracks token usage and estimated cost per farm and feature and enforces budget caps, across ai_usage_metrics, ai_cost_alerts and ai_budget_caps. NO VERIFY PHASE: this migration's VERIFY script does not use the repository's `VERIFY <letter> PASSED:` convention -- it emits free-text RAISE NOTICE lines the harness cannot score, so declaring expectedSections here would be a fiction. What this fixture proves is that the migration applies onto the bootstrap substrate and that its ROLLBACK returns the catalog to its exact pre-apply state. Budget enforcement is the half that matters commercially: these tables are what stand between a runaway AI job and an unbounded provider bill, so a rollback that half-removed them would leave cost tracking silently disabled rather than obviously broken.
